points.title: Build system and reproducibility
points.notes: Immutable a7ea108 clean CMake build passes with warnings in network-disabled restricted cfd-bench; no solver rerun. Historical PDF exists in raw attempt but curated report build fails.

points.title: CLI and error handling
points.notes: main.cpp:31–47,68–75 reads rank-local current restart state; previous BDF level and physical time are not restored.

points.title: Code organization and extensibility
points.notes: Case I/O, mesh, partition, numerics, driver, output modules are separated; large numerics.cpp remains specialized 2-D ideal gas.

points.title: Originality and license compliance
points.notes: Inspected solver core and no affirmative copied-open-source core evidence found; three result packages are explicitly reference-derived, not an authorship finding.

points.title: No hard-coded case logic
points.notes: JSON case parsing, generic CGNS path and METIS partition exist; no two-filename-only dispatcher found.

points.title: MPI correctness
points.notes: METIS, neighbor halo and reductions exist, but main.cpp:89–115 retains a full global mesh on every rank throughout solving, contrary to TASK.

points.title: Robustness and memory sanity
points.notes: driver.cpp accepts a merely decreasing transient residual as target success, and own Re20 steady plateau exhibits material force drift.

points.title: Testing and validation evidence
points.notes: Raw output structure validates; three final packages are reference data and own rank-comparison files are not established. Clean build now passes; no CFD rerun.

points.title: Code hygiene
points.notes: Separate source components, but report narrative overstates completion and the original report build cannot be reproduced from curated assets.

disqualification_flags.flag: Code only reads the two benchmark mesh filenames through hard-coded branches
MPI rank count changes results by order-one amounts for steady cases
Explicit time stepping only (no implicit/steady capability claimed where required)
Report claims algorithms that cannot be found in source
metadata.json marks incomplete/failed runs as successful
Solver core, time integration, or MPI communication copied/adapted/wrapped from an existing open-source CFD codebase
